book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: 1 TESALONICENSES Nacharam ẽsap Pabloou Tesalónicapienag phã deepʉ̈itarr

content: Mag pãar jãga nʉ a khap am khõchag chirʉmjã pöd maba aawai Atenas phöbör ee mʉch appai thʉbawi

jũrr maach khodam Timoteota mua pʉ̈ijim, ĩchab Cristo iek jawaag Ẽwandamau ichig nem mag aawai bʉ̈ʉrjã i ichaaur magʉm aba khitaawai. Iita mua pʉ̈ijim, pãar oon mawia pãachdëu ʉ̈kha nʉm iek gaai ubʉ naamkhĩir warag pãrag jaaumkhĩir,
maagwai jãg phithurg aadëphʉm gaaimuajã ni iwiir ãbjã deeu ewag mam ugua. Pãrau khaphʉ nʉm, maachin ich jãgta Ẽwandamau ich gaaimua phithurg ãwat wënʉrrapim khõsi sim.

Maach ipaarmua nawejã marau pãrag, ichiita maachin ich jãg õrau maach dʉ̈i khaigba nʉm gaaimua ökhĩirjugjã ãwatab khaba ãwat wënʉrraju a jaau naajim. Magtarr aawai chadcha ag ee öbërjim. Majã pãrau khaphʉ nʉm.

Mag pãar jãga nʉ a khap am khõchag chirʉm tag mʉchdëu ãwatba aadeewaita mua Timoteo pʉ̈ijim, jãga pãrau Ẽwandam iek pãachdëu ʉ̈khatarr ee wënʉrrʉ́ a khap jëeumkhĩir. Mua pãar khĩirju chirajim, eeu dëgölp dösãtau khãijã pãrag nem khaigba waupibarm gaaimua deeu khãijã ewag ërëu phöbaadeewai sĩi parta maach phidkhabarmjö aju khĩirjuwia.

Mamʉ ya ʉ̈u deeu Timoteo Tesalónicamua barbaichëm, pãar oothurwia. I iek mag pãar Ẽwandam iek gaai ubʉnaa pãach khapeenjã agdaujö khõsi nʉm aajem. I iek mag ĩchab pãach garmuajã maar khĩir eyaanaa maar oom khõchag naajem aajem, ich jãg maraujã pãar oom khõchag naajemjö.
Khodamnaan, maguata mʉg phithurg aadëphʉm dʉ̈i gaai machagjã aadëp ab mamʉ, maar dʉ̈rrcha onee naajem, pãrau pãachdëu ʉ̈khatarr iek gaai ogdʉba agtha pëdurraawai.
Mag maach Pör Jesucristo dʉ̈ita pãar ubʉ nʉm a ũurwaita maachpajã warag khĩirdam ubʉ aphöbaadeejem.
Jãga akhiin mʉg pãar gaaimua Ẽwandam na maach onee nʉm paar agpierr irig ʉ̈u ajim abpʉ̈ikham.
Edaram magwe Ẽwandamag jëeu durrumua deeu ũwaai pãar dʉ̈i khĩircha oobarkhiina a durraajem, mag ãba nʉisiewai agtha pãrau khaugba nʉmdam jaaubarmua khaugbaawai warag ubʉ nʉisimkhĩir.
Ẽwandam maach Ayau maach Pör Jesús dʉ̈imua maar pʉ̈ikhiin ʉ̈u akham a durraajem, pãar oon wëtaag.
Mag dʉ̈i ĩchab maach Pör Jesuugjã pãar kõit jëeu nʉm, ich jãg maachdëujã pãar khõsi nʉmjö pãarjã warag agdaujö thumaa jũrr chikham kha khõsi apimkhĩir.

Ichdëuta pãar thãarjã ãba ichigta khĩirjupinaa bʉ̈ʉrjã pekau chukhu wai sĩepim khõsi nʉm maach Aai Ẽwandam na, deeu ũwaai thum ich igar ʉ̈kha thʉnʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈i bëe nʉm ora. Ich mag maachdëu jëeu nʉmjö akhiin ʉ̈u akham keena.
